sources.title: Multi-million pound regeneration and housing boost for communities across England as National Housing Bank announces new deals
sources.publisher: National Housing Bank and Homes England
sources.verified_claim: The National Housing Bank announced £35 million of purpose-led loan deals supporting around 2,500 homes and regeneration in three locations; this demonstrates an active national financing mechanism but does not evidence funding for the three sample parcels.

sources.title: Crackdown on baseless legal claims to get Britain building
sources.verified_claim: Government launched consultation on extending judicial-review reforms to major housing, transport and energy developments; it is a proposed process reform and does not establish faster delivery for a particular parcel.

sources.title: Planning enforcement
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's enforcement page provides an enforcement register updated through 30 June 2026 and distinguishes permitted development from breaches; compliance history must be checked separately from growth potential.

sources.title: Planning consultation
sources.verified_claim: Havering states valid planning applications normally have a fixed 21-day consultation period before decision, providing process traceability without indicating any sample application outcome.

sources.title: Call for sites
sources.verified_claim: Havering explicitly states sites submitted through its Call for Sites are not automatically allocated and gain no special status; further assessment and consultation are required before any future allocation.

sources.title: Draft London Plan consultation events
sources.verified_claim: City Hall lists July and August 2026 consultation events for boroughs, businesses and Londoners, confirming the plan remains an active consultation rather than adopted policy.

sources.title: Help shape the new London Plan - consultation now open
sources.verified_claim: Talk London confirms the Draft London Plan is open for consultation until 15 October 2026 and will be independently examined before adoption, preserving draft-policy status.

sources.title: Draft London Plan consultation online drop-in sessions
sources.verified_claim: City Hall schedules August 2026 themed sessions on homes, transport, design, heritage and other chapters; these sessions reinforce that policy details remain subject to consultation and clarification.
